verdict.rationale: Lithic's Auth Rules v2, its closest analog to automations, supports draft rules that can run in shadow mode against the live authorization stream without affecting outcomes. Performance reports and backtesting let you review a draft's impact before it takes effect. This covers drafting and review of rule changes, but explicit rule version history and rollback to a prior version are not documented, and API date-versioning concerns the API itself rather than user automations. missing for 10: documented rule version history, rollback to prior rule versions, diff/approval review workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration
